# Generated content: do not edit by hand

Everything in this folder is a **Docusaurus build**, generated by **M-Files Spec Collector**. Every page's text is both in its `index.html` and in a minified chunk under `assets/js/`, and the release step replaces the whole folder. Hand edits don't survive and don't fully work either.

| Part of the reference | Source |
|---|---|
| UIX v2 interfaces, models, enums and events (`UIExt2/**`) | The vNext repository (GitHub `M-Files-Cloud/m-files-vnext`): the JSDoc in `MFCore/src/MFClientScript/` (`I*.ts`, `Models/*.ts`, `Events/*.ts`) and the public typings in `Packages/Public/UIExtTypeScript/src/`. Run `gulp Build:Mesp` in vNext after interface changes. Members with `@ignore` are left out. |
| gRPC interfaces and messages (`gRPC/**`) | `test/source/mfiles.proto` in Spec Collector, which is a copy of the M-Files Core UIX proto `src/Build/IDL/gRPC/uiext/mfiles.combined.generated.proto` (GitLab `m-files/m-files`). That proto is generated from the IDL in `src/Build/IDL/` (`RPC/*.idl`, `Struct/MF_*.idl`), so field and method comments come from the IDL `//!<` comments. The Spec Collector copy has extra messages at the end that Core does not, so don't overwrite it wholesale. |
| Samples (`Samples/**`) and overview pages | MDX written by hand in Spec Collector, `test/output/docs/uix2/docs/` |

- **Generator:** M-Files Spec Collector, GitLab `R-n-D/utilities/m-files-spec-collector`. Clone it next to `m-files-vnext`, run `npm install`, `npm run build`, then `npm run vnext_docs`.
- **Publishing:** follow `RELEASING.md` in Spec Collector. Build with Docusaurus in `test/output/docs/uix2` (needs Node 20.18 or later), then copy the build into this folder.
- **Process page:** Confluence ENG "Updating UIX Developer Documentation" (page 881197064).

This file starts with `_`, so Jekyll does not publish it. `RELEASING.md` says to empty this folder before copying a new build, so keep or restore this file when you do. A copy in the Docusaurus `static/` folder of Spec Collector would make it ship with every build.
